facts.text: Eat first, Daniel san. After dinner you wash the car, then paint the fence.
facts.why: Miyagi never says this. The film's chores are wax the car, paint the fence and sand the floor, but not in this line. A real food line of his is 'Man who catch fly with chopsticks accomplish anything.'
facts.fix: Man who catch fly with chopsticks accomplish anything.
